exposure: infection control measures related to COVID-19
outcome: Duration of treatment until decision in ED
Proportion of women admitted to delivery unit in active labor
Proportion of types and modes of delivery
cohort: Women referred to an obstetrical emergency department or delivering in a hospital unit in Israel during specific periods in 2019 and 2020.
finding: Most routine obstetrical care metrics, including duration of treatment, referral indications, and types and modes of delivery, did not significantly differ between the COVID-19 period and the previous year, although ED referrals decreased in the last week and active labor admissions increased in the last three weeks, suggesting that negative impacts can be reduced with proper management.
mod_finding: The proportion of types and modes of delivery did not differ between the COVID-19 period (February-March 2020) and the parallel period in the previous year (February-March 2019).
cross-section timing: Retrospective data comparison between February-March 2020 and February-March 2019.
